name: globocan-mcp
description: Keyless Cloudflare Worker MCP exposing IARC's Global Cancer Observatory (GLOBOCAN 2022) to the evidentia plugin: global/country cancer incidence and mortality estimates (36 sites, 185+ countries incl. Türkiye) with ASR, crude rate, cumulative risk, rank and uncertainty intervals. Live proxy over the authless gco-api.iarc.fr; closes evidentia's global cancer-burden gap.
